model.summary: Model favors IND by 4.7 points (64% win chance). Biggest factors: Rushing offense EPA/play (recent-weighted) (IND +0.9), Scoring margin (last 8 games) (IND +0.5), Home team changed QB (IND +0.4). The baseline of +1.9 covers typical home-field advantage.

total_model.summary: Model projects 43.9 total points (IND 24, MIA 20). Biggest factors: Combined quarterback ratings (lowers total 2.3), Combined offense EPA/play (last 8 games) (lowers total 2.2), Combined pass defense EPA allowed/play (raises total 1.5). The baseline of 45.7 is the typical NFL total in the training data.

qb_what_if.note: Approximate: swaps only the quarterback rating and the model's QB-change flag (a new starter counts as a change). Team offense and defense form stay as they are. A positive margin change favors the home team.
